scene: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual direction reference ONLY for Ki Legends, a modern original anime fantasy top-down 2D browser RPG. Create one wide overhead gameplay composition of a beautiful forest starting village, WITHOUT UI or text. Orthographic top-down RPG camera, north-up rectangular paths, no horizon, no isometric diamond layout. Contemporary anime background painting with clean hand-inked shapes, broad elegant cel-shaded color masses and subtle brush texture, absolutely NO pixel art, no photorealism and no 3D rendering. Harmonious emerald and mint foliage, warm cream plaster, teal curved tile roofs, pale warm soil pathways, turquoise clear stream, soft blue-violet shadows. Four individually legible small buildings, lush canopy clusters at edges, spacious traversable winding village paths, wooden bridge, flowers as subtle accents. One clearly readable original anime human adventurer centered, dark navy spiky hair, cream tunic, short teal coat, coral scarf, dark trousers, boots, single sheathed sword, approximately five-head-tall proportions; height roughly one third of a house facade, not a tiny pixel dot. Match environment and hero perspective. Warm gentle daylight from upper left. Zoomed-out view with ample navigable space, polished contemporary 2D anime game art, restrained fine detail. No framed panels, no concept collage, no branding, no letters. This is a scene reference, not a production map.
terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual seamless repeatable square grass material sample for Ki Legends modern anime fantasy TOP DOWN 2D game. Fill entire square edge to edge with flat overhead stylized grass, harmonious emerald jade mint and warm yellow-green palette, broad soft hand-painted anime color shapes and sparse small clean tapered brushstrokes suggesting blades. Low-contrast evenly distributed detail, no central focal point, no large tufts, no distinct repeating flowers, no dirt, no objects, no lighting gradients, no border. Contemporary polished anime background painting; not pixel art, not realistic grass photography, not 3D. All four edges should connect seamlessly when repeated, equal lighting and color across edges. Texture only, no perspective, no horizon, no text. Keep large simple calm color areas so repeated terrain is readable at game scale rather than noisy stippling.
